items.title: Running Thoughts: Haliburton’s emotional return, Siakam’s late heroics and a Pacers opening-night win
items.body_excerpt: Tyrese Haliburton scored 13 of his 23 points in the fourth quarter. (Photo: DAZN) A new Pacers season got underway Wednesday evening in New Orleans, with excitement building for this team and the return of Tyrese Haliburton . It had been a long, long time since the Pacers played…
